label: Построенный
description: A 10-sentence card for построенный, the past passive participle of построить, with its short form построен.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative long form. Построенный comes from the perfective построить on -ить — the stem postroj plus the suffix -енн- and an adjective ending. The long form agrees with masculine дом.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative long form. The long participle takes -ая to agree with школа. Построенная школа equals школа, которую построили — the school that someone built.

missions.phrase: Построенное на холме здание видно издалека.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Neuter nominative long form. Построенное carries the neuter ending -ое to match здание. The -енн- suffix from -ить marks the result — the building that was erected.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative long form. The plural ending -ые lets построенные agree with мосты as the built bridges that joined the two banks.

missions.phrase: Этот дом построен сто лет назад.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine short form. The short predicative form построен agrees only in masculine gender with дом, with быть understood. It states when the house was built.
Strategic focus: Feminine short form with быть. The short form построена joins была to form a past passive: школа была построена. It reports that the school got built.
Strategic focus: Plural short form. The plural short form построены agrees with дома and predicates the result with быть understood. The new houses are built.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental long form. After горжусь the noun домом stands in the instrumental, and построенным takes the matching masculine instrumental ending to agree with it.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о построенном недавно стадионе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional long form. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so стадионе and построенном take prepositional endings and agree as the stadium that was built.

missions.phrase: Я вижу построенную из кирпича стену.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine accusative long form. With the object стену the participle takes the accusative -ую, so построенную matches it in gender, number and case as the wall that was built.
